system.description: Old blood flows through your veins, and something about you makes elders nervous or curious. This attention is usually unwelcome and comes in the form of mistrust, fear, or obsession — some whisper that you are a harbinger of Caine, others see Malkav's madness upon you and give you a wide berth. You suffer a one-Trait penalty on all Social challenges with elders that depend on trust, because they fear you.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis IV: Thieves in the Night, Book Three: Madmen
